items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: We had Earle go into different places and get us food... Earle Warren and them, Well, /they used to call me Fanny.

ctx.x: Any of the guys too hot tempered, you know?
No, they were, everybody was alright. I remember one time we got on the train and you know, Earle Warren ?
